description: This PHP file defines the ViewRelationship class, which manages the display and editing of module relationships within the SuiteCRM module builder interface. It handles the creation, modification, and display of relationship definitions between modules, including loading related modules, managing relationship types, and rendering templates for the user interface.

classes.name: ViewRelationship
classes.description: Manages the module relationship configuration interface, including loading existing relationships, handling user input, and rendering the relationship form within SuiteCRM's Module Builder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the current module view.

methods.name: overrideDefinitionFromPOST
methods.description: Overrides relationship definition keys with POST request data unless they are labels loaded via ajax.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to prepare data and render the relationship view/template, including handling different module contexts, relationship types, and user interactions.
